title: SG-4.4 · Apply device pixel ratio at runtime
summary: Pass computeZoom(window.devicePixelRatio, container size) into the Phaser game and refresh it on resize
description: Context: game/frontend/src/phaser/config.ts exports computeZoom(w,h,dpr) but nothing calls it. buildGameConfig sets no zoom, and PhaserHost's ResizeObserver only calls scale.refresh(). Desired behavior: the zoom computed from window.devicePixelRatio and the container size is passed into the game config at creation, and recomputed in the ResizeObserver callback and when the ratio changes. Expected result: Phaser-mocked unit tests show the zoom is passed in and refreshed on resize. Why: the pixel-art scene stays crisp on high-DPI and resized displays.
acceptance_criteria: Given a container of 1280x720 and dpr 2, when PhaserHost mounts, then createGame receives zoom equal to computeZoom(1280,720,2)
Given a mounted PhaserHost, when the ResizeObserver callback fires with a new size or dpr, then scale.setZoom is called with the recomputed zoom and scale.refresh is called
Given a devicePixelRatio change, when the media query change event fires, then the zoom is recomputed and applied

preserve: Single game instance and destroy(true) cleanup on unmount
pixelArt, roundPixels and FIT scale settings

technical_constraints: Unit tests mock createGame and Phaser, no real browser
definition_of_done: Both requirements verified by passing unit tests
